method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (32 PNGs in /private/tmp/claude-501/music-second-reader-2015ol/) and read every ask page in full (listening 2-6 and 8-11, composing 3-11); the remaining pages (listening 1, 7, 12-16; composing 1, 2, 12-16) were checked on a contact sheet and in the text layer (cover, BLANK PAGE, ROUGH WORK only). PyMuPDF clips at 300 dpi on every glyph in doubt: the Q1 lead-in and its two bullets (p2), the hyphen in "bars 1-6" (p2 Excerpt 3 heading), the en dashes in "bars 1–4" (Q2), "lines 1–2" (Q4(i)) and "bars 1–16" (Q6 Excerpt 1), the curly apostrophe in "Sgt. Pepper’s" and "played THREE times." (Q4), the Q5 heading "Irish Music" (no full stop) and its unbulleted paragraph, the Q6 heading "Aural Skills." and "THREE" (capitals on the page, lower case in the text layer), the Section A stem (full stop after "Q3.") and title, the poem's double space "who  dwell" (p4), the Section B stem (no full stop after "Q6"), the em dashes in the four cadence lines (p7), and the B♭ flat sign (p8). Every questionText, questionContext, excerptLine, grid.stem and readFromPage string was also split at its bullets/newlines/tick boxes and matched as an exact, case-sensitive substring of the PyMuPDF text layer of its pages; the only misses were the known ones (Q6 "THREE" stored lower case, "B♭" stored "Bb", stems printed on p3/p6 rather than on the ask's page), each settled on the render. Lyric line numbers 1.-7. and every lyric word were read off the p6 render and text layer. Addresses were checked against the printed numbering (Q1/Q5/Q6 parts numbered afresh under each excerpt; Q2-Q4 (i)-(v); Section A Q1-Q3 (a)/(b); Section B Q4-Q6).
